snippet.title: Super reaKtor Release date Trailer
snippet.description:
Super reaKtor comes to Steam on November 21st !

Collect Energy, Protect your 2 Weakpoints and Absorb hostile bullets in this frantic bullet hell with original controls et mechanics.

WISHLIST and play the DEMO on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3077190/Super_reaKtor/

Follow us on our socials : 
https://linktr.ee/superreaktor
